title: derived_pattern — 04a1 provenance block
description: The one field the 04a1 fallback adds to an otherwise-standard 04a strategy.json (see ../../04a-fix-strategist/templates/strategy.schema.json). Present ONLY on a plan derived because the CWE had no catalog entry. It records where the derived pattern came from so a reviewer and the downstream audit stage can trace every recommendation to a real, local, version-controlled source — never the model's memory.

source_type.description: Where the pattern came from. 'expanded-catalog'/'historical-fix' are local and citable (preferred). 'external' means an out-of-repo source and must be treated as lowest confidence.

sources.description: Repo-relative paths (ideally with #Ln) the pattern was drawn from, e.g. knowledge/refs/path-traversal.md#L1.

kb_entry.description: The CWE key looked up in knowledge/remediation-kb.json, e.g. CWE-22.

ranked_examples.description: The historical fixes considered, most-relevant first, ranked by a hybrid score: keyword/synonym overlap, TF-IDF cosine similarity, and (when the local embedding model is set up) real sentence-embedding cosine similarity, weighted-averaged against the root-cause text (see ../ranking-weights.json and scripts/lib/fallback.js: rankExamples).

score.description: Weighted average of keyword_score, tfidf_score, and embedding_score (whichever are available), renormalized to 0-1.

tfidf_score.description: TF-IDF cosine similarity against the root-cause text, corpus = every historical fix in the KB (0-1).

embedding_score.description: Cosine similarity between real local sentence-transformer embeddings of the root-cause text and this fix's text (0-1). `null` if the local model isn't set up on this machine -- the other two signals are used instead, never a crash.

matched_synonyms.description: Synonym hits, as "keyword -> matched synonym" strings.

note.description: One line stating the plan was derived via fallback and needs human review.
